title: Marriage in 1922 and the photograph of the band
summary: Bella says Willie married her in 1922 while playing with the Eureka; they discuss the photo of him with the little boys and who has his music.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: That's the gang he was with when he married me. That's the gang he was with when he married me. When were you married? Do you remember the year? Do I? He married me in 1922. 1922? He was playing with the Eureka then. He was playing then.
You know when that picture was taken with the little boys?

That's what I'm trying to find. How long ago? Was that when you first married him? Oh, he had that when I married him. Oh, Lord, I don't know nothing about that. He had that before I married him, but I wish I could find that little picture. So y'all could see it.
I sure would like to know who has the music.
